paper_title: No evidence for axions from Chandra observation of magnetic white dwarf
notes: Product constraint on two couplings: g_aγγ × g_aee < 1.3 × 10^-25 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for m_a < 10^-5 eV from Chandra X-ray non-observation of RE J0317-853. This is not a direct constraint on g_aγγ alone but on the product with axion-electron coupling g_aee. The paper discusses two model scenarios: (i) tree-level DFSZ with C_aee = C_aγγ, and (ii) loop-induced KSVZ with C_aee ≈ 1.5×10^-8 C_aγγ. Conversion to a single g_aγγ limit requires model-specific assumptions about the relationship between C_aee and C_aγγ. The constraint applies across the entire low-mass range m_a < 10^-5 eV with no mass-dependent structure presented. Observation details: 37.42 ks Chandra ACIS-I exposure on 2020-12-18, modern 40 ks dataset. The non-observation of axion-induced X-ray signals from bremsstrahlung and electro-Primakoff production constrains the coupling product. For higher masses m_a > 10^-5 eV, the constraint weakens as different production mechanisms dominate.
